name: EPIC 210696040
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 14.5 solar radii and 2.22 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210696040 (K2 campaign 13): PARAM radius (solar radii) 14.483079 (16th-84th percentiles 13.088646-15.097022), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,917 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 2.22 solar masses and 14.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,991 K at its surface.
